content.introduction: Bitcoin price today steadied at $95,579.0 by 09:47 ET (14:47 GMT), hovering around its strongest level in two months, according to Investing.com. This recovery followed a sluggish start to the year, with the cryptocurrency still remaining well below the $100,000 level. The stabilization occurred as markets digested a proposed U.S. bill that intends to create a regulatory framework for cryptocurrency.
